title: Integrated performance assessment of vacuum heat pump drying: a multi-criteria framework for energy-quality optimization in banana slice drying
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00546A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thanapon Saengsuwan, Narathip Sujinda
An integrated assessment framework was developed to optimize vacuum heat pump drying of green banana slices, achieving 46% faster drying, 83% higher exergy efficiency, and superior color and vitamin C retention.
